VOTING INFORMATION
State Election -November 3, 2026 -
INFORMATION FOR VOTERS- 2026 Ballot Questions
Voting will take place at the Sunderland Public Library, 20 School Street, Sunderland, MA from 7:00am-8:00pm.
Register to vote by 5:00pm on October 24,2026 in the Town Clerk’s office or see link below to register online.
Vote by mail application deadline: October 27, 2026, 5pm
Early voting Hours for the State Election
will be held in the Town Clerk’s office, 12 School Street, Sunderland.
Saturday   October 17, 2026    8:00am-12:00pm
Monday   October 19, 2026,     9:00am-6:00pm
Tuesday, October 20, 2026     9:00am-4:00pm
